properties.text: agent-vm is the program that makes and runs boxes; AgentVM, Terminal and Cadabra all run the same one. It comes from github.com/abra-code/agent-vm as a package signed by its developer and notarized by Apple, which AgentVM checks before installing it.
It is installed for you only, and no password is asked: the programs go into ~/.local/share/agent-vm, in a folder for each version, and ~/.local/bin gets the links agent-vm and avm.

properties.title: Add ~/.local/bin to my shell's PATH, so that avm and agent-vm are found in Terminal
properties.help: Adds a marked block of lines to your shell's startup file (~/.zprofile for zsh). Nothing is added when the file already names ~/.local/bin.

properties.title: Download and Install
properties.help: Download the newest agent-vm, check its signature, and install it.
